$comment: The shell every page renders: footer facts, trademark notice, byline, badges, shared UI labels. English is the source; these are the exact words the site shipped before extraction.

brand.tagline: Independent DevEx payout estimates for Roblox creators, with every figure traced to an official source.

footer.perEligibleNote: Per eligible Earned Robux, before any payment-provider fee or tax.
footer.trademarkNotice: DevExCalculator.org is an independent tool. Roblox, Robux and Developer Exchange are trademarks of Roblox Corporation, used here only to describe the subject of these calculations. This site is not endorsed, sponsored or operated by Roblox Corporation, and it cannot determine whether any DevEx request will be approved.
footer.copyright: © {year} {siteName}. Every payout figure is an estimate.

sourceCheck.changedHeading: Roblox’s page no longer matches these figures.
sourceCheck.changedBody: Found by the automatic check on {checked}. The figures above stand until a person has read what changed.
sourceCheck.unreadableBody: Roblox’s page could not be read on {checked}, so these figures are the ones from the last review rather than a fresh comparison.
sourceCheck.sourceUpdatedAt: Roblox last updated that page on {date}.
sourceCheck.unreadableReason: The document does not read as Roblox’s DevEx page.

callouts.estimateTitle: This is an estimate, not a decision
callouts.earnedRobuxOnlyTitle: DevEx applies to Earned Robux only
callouts.estimateBody: Figures here use the rates Roblox currently documents. Roblox alone decides which of your Robux count as Earned Robux, which rate applies to which part of your balance, and whether a DevEx request is approved. Payment-provider fees and your own tax obligations are not included unless you add them.
callouts.earnedRobuxOnlyBody: Robux you bought, received as a gift, or acquired outside creator earnings are not Earned Robux and cannot be cashed out. Retail Robux pricing is a separate thing entirely and is never mixed into these figures.
callouts.methodologyBody: Calculations use exact decimal arithmetic and round only at the point of display; required-Robux figures always round up.

sections.seeEverySource: See every source and its review cadence
sections.reportOutOfDate: report something that is out of date

consentHeading.p2: We would like to measure which pages get used, which needs a cookie. The calculator works identically either way, and your calculations are never sent anywhere.
